name: compLeft_apply
statement: C(β, γ)} (hg : g 0 = 0) (f : C_c(α, β)) (a : α) : f.compLeft g a = g (f a)

name: exists_add_nnrealPart_add_eq
statement: C_c(α, ℝ)) : ∃ (h : C_c(α, ℝ≥0)), (f + g).nnrealPart + h = f.nnrealPart + g.nnrealPart ∧ (-f + -g).nnrealPart + h = (-f).nnrealPart + (-g).nnrealPart
